summary: 21-year-old female hiker died in a hiking incident near Flying Dutchman Ridge in Rocky Mountain National Park.
location: Flying Dutchman Ridge, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Decedent identified as Jadyn Weiss, 21; coroner examination completed with cause and manner pending further investigation at time of release. Run-585 merge: NPS Aug-13-2023 release (parent-opened) corroborates — 21-yo female from Severance died in ~300-ft fall in the Flying Dutchman couloir (between Longs Peak and Mt. Meeker) Aug 12; 25-yo male critically injured, CANG hoist with RMRG assist, 31 people involved. Run-927 merge: NPS Aug-14-2023 recovery release (parent-opened) — body recovery completed Monday 2023-08-14 via Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control helicopter, flown to Upper Beaver Meadows, Boulder County Coroner.
